records.title: Rail launch
records.body: Led the station-map launch for the Harbor rail project; opened on schedule after a two-week field trial.

records.title: Correction
records.body: Correction: the Harbor launch was in May, not April.

records.title: Mentoring
records.body: Mentored two new analysts; weekly paired reviews helped both ship their first reports.

records.title: Research
records.body: Interviewed twelve ferry riders and found the timetable labels caused most missed connections.

records.title: Incident
records.body: During the storm outage, coordinated a six-person response and restored the public status page before dawn.

records.title: Writing
records.body: A one-page decision memo helped the committee choose the lower-cost depot option.

records.title: Short progress
records.body: This week the prototype passed the accessibility audit; keyboard navigation still needs follow-up.

records.title: Correction
records.body: Correction: the prototype passed keyboard checks, but the screen-reader audit is still open.

records.title: Community
records.body: Organized a neighborhood repair clinic where volunteers fixed twenty bicycles in one afternoon.

records.title: Budget
records.body: Negotiated a print contract that reduced the annual field-guide budget by fifteen percent.

records.title: Learning
records.body: Learned enough SQL to replace a weekly manual spreadsheet reconciliation with a checked query.

records.title: Handoff
records.body: Created a handoff checklist that let the night team operate the exhibit without calling the day team.

records.title: Feedback
records.body: After visitor feedback, moved the ticket desk beside the entrance and shortened the queue.

records.title: Short progress
records.body: The grant draft is complete; the partner letter is the only remaining item before Friday.

records.title: Partnership
records.body: Built a library partnership that brought the mobile science workshop to four rural schools.

records.title: Quality
records.body: Added a second reviewer to the translation workflow and caught a recurring units error.

records.title: Planning
records.body: Split the migration into reversible stages so the archive stayed available during the move.

records.title: Decision
records.body: Chose a smaller pilot after the first estimate showed the full rollout exceeded staff capacity.

records.title: Presentation
records.body: Presented the watershed findings to the council and answered questions with the original measurements.

records.title: Follow-up
records.body: The replacement sensors arrived today; installation is booked for Tuesday morning.
